name: Haruko Valentine
source: Professional wrestler. She wants to surpass his teacher Yasmina, although she is still quite far from reaching her level. She is a bit rough around the edges, but she has a kind and sensitive side that she shows to people who treat her with respect. She is currently in a romantic relationship with Amy Agile North.
